action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that the rcp client in rsh incorrectly handled filenames
of . or empty filenames received from the server. If a user were tricked
into connecting to a malicious rsh server, an attacker could possibly use
this issue to modify the permissions of the target directory.
(CVE-2019-7282)

It was discovered that the rcp client in rsh did not properly validate
filenames received from the server. If a user were tricked into connecting
to a malicious rsh server, an attacker could possibly use this issue to
overwrite arbitrary files in the target directory. (CVE-2019-7283)
isummary: rsh could be made to overwrite files or modify directory permissions if it connected to a malicious server.
